description: DART key file version 1 reference vectors (docs/KEY_FILE_FORMAT.md, section 11). Each `valid` file MUST open with `password` (whose UTF-8 bytes are `passwordHex`) to the 128-byte plaintext `secretKeyHex`, the keys of the `keys` entry of tests/vectors/derivation-v1.json; encrypting `secretKeyHex` with `salt`, `nonce` and the `scrypt` parameters MUST reproduce `encoded` byte for byte. Each `invalid` file (JSON text) MUST be rejected, at step `step` of the reader procedure (section 7); `error` is the class of error: invalid, unsupported, password, corrupted or publicKeyMismatch.
